request.message:
Superbowl
We need to build a workflow...
We will receive two SRT feeds from Grass Valley.
They will each go through Uplynk and land in a single live event for redundancy.
The event is the Super Bowl. We will broadcast it OTT and it will also go out to YouTube as well as to three other syndication partners. YouTube will receive HLS Pull
For the other syndication partners, we will push SRT.

Additionally, another partner is going to feed us an HLS stream and that will follow a different path which will go through Uplynk and into a linear channel with scheduling enabled. This path will go out OTT 24-7.

reply: Set up both SRT feeds going through Grass Valley prep and their own transcode paths into one Super Bowl live event, which fans out to OTT, YouTube, and three separate SRT syndication outputs. The HLS partner feed gets its own repackaging path into a scheduled 24/7 channel with its own OTT output, since live events and channels each need a separate OTT per platform rules. One thing to confirm: YouTube's HLS Pull detail isn't a configurable field on the Social block, so I just set the platform to YouTube.
summary: Built two redundant SRT feeds through Grass Valley prep into a Super Bowl live event branching to OTT, YouTube, and three SRT syndication partners, plus a separate HLS partner feed into a scheduled 24/7 linear channel with its own OTT output.

reply: Combined both feed preps into one Grass Valley instance — both SRT feeds now downlink into it before splitting to their separate ingest/transcode paths. Also added captions to the Super Bowl event.
summary: Merged the two feed preps into a single shared Grass Valley instance and added captions to the Super Bowl event.
